It is most likely a permission-related problem.

Please check your Android settings (App management/MyHabits/Notifications) to confirm whether the app has the right to send notifications at all.
Additionally, a second permission must be granted for "allow scheduled alarms."

Soon I will add a dialog which shows all given (and needed) permissions
